summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per instructions; a line-length scan found no lines over 120 columns. Nothing is committed. Choices made: missing image/label keys are skipped; non-object top-level JSON or non-list key values raise ValueError; invalid JSON propagates as its ValueError subclass; items are copied before resolution.
